test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Radhe Sham Barle received the Padma Shri in 2020-21 for promoting the Panthi dance of tribals from the Santnami community on the birth anniversary of Guru Ghasidas. Which state does this dance form belong to?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Chhattisgarh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The correct answer is option 2, Chhattisgarh.**
 
• Panthi dance is a **traditional folk dance of the Santnami community of Chhattisgarh.**
 
• This dance form is performed on the occasion of **Guru Ghasidas Jayanti, which is celebrated in honor of the founder of the Satnami sect.**
 
• The dance is characterized by its rhythmic movements and **foot-tapping beats, accompanied by the melodious sound of the 'manjiras' and 'dholak'.**
 
• The dance is performed by both men and women and is a popular form of entertainment in rural areas of Chhattisgarh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bihar **- Bihar has its own traditional folk dances like** Jat-Jatin, Jhijhia, and Jumari.**
 
• **Madhya Pradesh **- Madhya Pradesh has its own traditional folk dances like** Gond, Bhilala, and Baiga.**
 
• ** Odisha **- Odisha has its own traditional folk dances like **Ghumura, Sambalpuri, and Dalkhai.**
